admission_after_download: join every archive member to the frozen official image metadata
retain train split rows with exact CC-BY-2.0 license and attribution fields
decode RGB and require both dimensions at least 224 pixels
global exact pixel-byte and perceptual near-image deduplication
remove downstream validation and test overlaps before packing
run deterministic visual and safety audits before TRAINING_ADMITTED
claim_boundary: This contract authorizes resumable acquisition and integrity checks for the official CVDF Open Images train archive. Downloaded bytes are not training-admitted images until the metadata, license, content, deduplication, contamination, split and human-audit gates pass.

transport.launch_control: Slurm job over strict host-key SSH
transport.rationale: ParaCloud compute-node HTTPS egress is blocked; the login node has verified public egress and shared /ssd access.
